title: OKForest settings
description: OKForest's settings for an OKF bundle, in .okforest/settings.yaml. Every setting is optional. An OKForest convention, not part of OKF. Docs: https://www.okforest.ai/docs/settings/
markdownDescription: OKForest's settings for an OKF bundle, in `.okforest/settings.yaml`. Every setting is optional. An OKForest convention, not part of OKF. [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/settings/)

name.description: The bundle's display name. At most 100 characters.
name.markdownDescription: The bundle's display name. At most 100 characters. [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/settings/#name)

description.description: What the bundle covers. At most 4,000 characters.
description.markdownDescription: What the bundle covers. At most 4,000 characters. [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/settings/#description)
examples: Pricing, discounts, and deal desk policies for the sales team.

ignore.description: Globs, relative to the bundle root, of markdown files that are not concepts. * matches within a folder name, ** across folders, ? one character; a trailing / matches a whole folder.
ignore.markdownDescription: Globs, relative to the bundle root, of markdown files that are not concepts. `*` matches within a folder name, `**` across folders, `?` one character; a trailing `/` matches a whole folder. [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/settings/#ignore)
